full_details: Before the bells the loaf was still a thumb short of the notch, and still a penny. Yesterday's butter had been fourpence. Verbeke came to church with the house, because not to come would be noticed. If he were asked, the answer was Norwich. Master Thwaite preached that the powers that be are ordained of God, that masters are to keep their servants in, and whoso resisteth. He turned the glass once and set it down. Halberds stood at the Mayor's pew. Sir John sat behind them and did not speak. You came home. After dark a neighbour stood on the step and said apprentices had gone against the Counter in the Poultry and taken the prisoners out. He had heard it. He had not seen it. Mistress Ansell said yesterday butter, today a prison, and that they had left off asking. You went up. Late, you said a door opens if enough push, and that a city does not forget it.
one_sentence: You heard the ordinance at St Helen's, and after dark a neighbour brought the Counter to the step.
title: The ordinance at St Helen's, and a door after dark
